description: Read the text of a documentary credit (SWIFT MT700 as advised by the bank): credit number, dates, amount and tolerance, partial shipments and transhipment, latest shipment, ports, presentation period, goods, the documents required (each with how to make it) and additional conditions, plus a letter_of_credit object for create_trade_documents. Read here, nothing stored.
